Chapter.description: A named run of consecutive scenes in a long video.
Chapter.title: Chapter

ComparisonScene.description: A title and two labelled columns that contrast two things, with up to three points each.
ComparisonScene.title: ComparisonScene

ConceptScene.description: A title, one core statement and up to three points.
ConceptScene.title: ConceptScene

DefinitionScene.description: A title, one key term, its plain-language definition and an optional example.
DefinitionScene.title: DefinitionScene

FlowScene.description: A title and two to four nodes connected in order.
FlowScene.title: FlowScene

MapArea.description: Countries grouped together, such as the Allies or the Axis, named with today's borders.
MapArea.title: MapArea

MapScene.description: A map of one region with shaded country groups, labelled places and an optional route.
MapScene.title: MapScene

MotionAction.description:
Animate one property between fractional positions in narration lines, before audio exists.

The end line is included: endOffset=1 reaches its audio endpoint. Timeline compilation
produces the absolute frame interval [from, from + durationInFrames).
MotionAction.title: MotionAction

MotionCue.description: A stated physical operation synchronized to narration, independent of travel.
MotionCue.title: MotionCue

MotionEntity.description: Initial state on a stage measured in percentages, independent of output resolution.
MotionEntity.title: MotionEntity

MotionScene.description: Entities whose movement and property changes explain the narrated process.
MotionScene.title: MotionScene

ProcessEvent.description: A causal state change or deliberate hold, before layout and measured speech timing.
ProcessEvent.title: ProcessEvent

ProcessScene.description: A bounded arrival, waiting and processing workflow with explicit state transitions.
ProcessScene.title: ProcessScene

QuoteScene.description: A title and one short quotation with who said it.
QuoteScene.title: QuoteScene

StatScene.description: A title and one to three large numbers that count up, each with a short label.
StatScene.title: StatScene

TimelineScene.description: A title and two to five dated events along a line, in time order.
TimelineScene.title: TimelineScene

description: Scene-by-scene script: what each scene shows and what the narrator says.
title: ScenePlan
